body:
The desktop app's tests can't run under `test`, and when they fail the error is hard to read. Fix both. The findings and acceptance criteria are in note 4.

1. **Readable failure:** when the build fails before any test runs, `test` shows `Tests did not run.` followed only by cargo's `error:` block and its `Caused by:` lines, not the raw build log.
2. **Declared folder:** a project can list extra folders its build may write to in `solace.toml` (`[sandbox] write`), and the human approves that line. Each folder must be inside the project. Add `gen` for solace-app, so its build can write there and its tests run. Everything else in the project stays read-only.

This needs the change to D-158 point 4 proposed alongside this task.
title: app tests: declared build folder and readable failure
